title: Tim King, AmigaDOS developer, has died
summary: Tim King, a key developer of AmigaDOS for Commodore's Amiga platform, has passed away. He made significant contributions to the Amiga operating system, particularly the 1.3 release, and his work influenced the broader retro computing community.
problem_solved: This is a memorial piece marking the passing of a significant figure in computing history rather than a technical solution.
why_valuable: Preserves the memory of important contributors to computing history and acknowledges the legacy of retro computing pioneers.
